item.title: Men’s Basketball Falls 83-81 In Close Battle at Seattle
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Basketball fell 83-81 in a close battle with Seattle University on Wednesday Feb. 4 at the Redhawk Center in Seattle, Wash. Aaron Clark and Styles Phipps finished as the Waves top two scores, putting up 22 and 18 points respectively. item.title: Global Learning Week Shifts Students’ Lens
item.description: Pepperdine’s 12th annual Global Learning Week took place from Jan. 26-30. Hosted by International Programs, Global Learning Week celebrates global citizenship by deepening Pepperdine students' cross-cultural understanding with diverse events and hands-on activities. item.title: Women’s Basketball Find Success in Historic Start
item.description: The Pepperdine Women's Basketball team got off to their best start in 45 years with a 9-3 record. As they look toward March, the Waves are carrying their wins and losses with them through the rest of season. item.description: Students, faculty and staff are finding new ways to stay active on campus. Between fitness classes and club sports, Campus Recreation has helped the community balance wellness and fitness. The post Campus Recreation Keeps Community Active appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Gets Revenge Against the Cougars
item.description: Pepperdine Women's Basketball beat the Washington State University Cougars 78-62 in a revenge game Feb. 7 at Firestone Fieldhouse. The Waves now extend the win streak to four games, their largest streak of the season. The post Women’s Basketball Gets Revenge Against the Cougars appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.
